expectedSentences: Sparse attention reduces the quadratic cost of long context models to a manageable level.
Our contributions are summarised in the following list.
• A block sparse attention kernel • An analysis of the memory traffic • A scheduler for mixed block sizes • Experiments on six public corpora • An open source reference implementation
We use the following notation throughout the paper.

Block a contiguous span of keys Pattern the set of blocks that a query attends to Budget the number of blocks per query Router the module that selects blocks Kernel the fused implementation on the accelerator
The original proposal is stated in the following terms, which we quote in full.
attention is all you need and memory is all you have so spend it where the mass is and nowhere else at all that is the whole of the method
The sparse kernel reaches the same accuracy as the dense baseline on every task that we tried.
